task_description: Build a MongoDB-backed Express API (server/) and refactor the React client to consume it, within the existing npm-workspaces monorepo. Server: env/secrets handling, Mongo singleton + typed collections + GridFS, JWT auth, public reads, protected CRUD writes with whitelist discipline, assembled GET /api/league, PDF reports via GridFS, idempotent seed with admin bootstrap. Client: @bowling/shared adoption, API client, Vite /api proxy, LeagueContext provider, real JWT AuthContext, migrate six pages + Layout, new Reports page/route, delete client/src/types.ts and client/src/data/league.ts. Follow design.md exactly; design-review.md findings are requirements.
